extensionDescription.message: After a passkey login, sends the cookies of the site back to the built-in browser of kisui-terminal (only the sites you list there).

actionTitle.message: Send the login of this site back to kisui-terminal

errorBadRequest.message: kisui-terminal did not understand the request. Update kisui-terminal and this extension.

errorNotAllowed.message: This site is not in passkey_sites of kisui-terminal.

errorNotWaiting.message: kisui-terminal is not waiting for this site. Ask for the passkey again in the built-in browser (it waits 10 minutes).

errorNoCookies.message: This site has no cookies to send yet. Finish the login, then press the button again.

errorFailed.message: kisui-terminal could not take the login (is a tab of the built-in browser open?).

errorNotRunning.message: kisui-terminal is not running, or its native messaging host is not registered for this browser.

errorNoPermission.message: This extension needs access to the sites to read their cookies.
